correctness.rationale: The defining open-neighborhood condition at square (i,j) is exactly r_i+c_j-2x_ij>=2. The global minimum size8 follows by empty-column versus all-positive-column row-sum argument. All size8 optima split by column support into exact families of sizes 15,1080,1350,24,720, totaling 3189. Any legal single exchange preserves selected row and occupied-column support; only three-active-column configurations move. For each of 20 triples the four omitted-column symbols have multiplicity <=2 and yield a connected 54-state graph with 144 edges and diameter5. Independent complete C(24,8) binary subset enumeration reproduced count3189, 2880 exchange edges, degree histogram 2109/360/720, and no non-slide exchanges. The first-board cutoff requires checking the finite n*m<=24 grid, not an infinite family assertion.
